sentences.en: I anticipate that there will be problems on their expedition.
sentences.zh: 我预料他们在远征中会遇到问题。

sentences.en: The boy dreamed of going on an Antarctic expedition.
sentences.zh: 那个男孩梦想着去南极探险。

sentences.en: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
sentences.zh: 在此次考察中我们遇到了很多困难。

senses.zh: （为特定目的而组织的）旅行，出行，远征；远征队，探险队，考察队；迅速，动作敏捷
